newsitem.title: USA: Texas Biotechnology to offer 5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Texas Biotechnology to offer 5 mln shares.

text.p: Texas Biotechnology Corp filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of up to five million common shares.
Underwriters for the offering, Lehman Brothers Inc and PaineWebber Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 750,000 shares.
Proceeds from the sale will be used by the biopharamaceutical company to fund preclinical and clinical testing of its products used to treat cardiovascular and other diseases.
After the offering, the Houston, Texas, company will have 31,003,000 shares outstanding.
